title: Crispy fried chicken
steps: Soak chicken in buttermilk, hot sauce, and 1 tsp salt at least 1 hour.
Mix flour with remaining salt and spices.
Dredge chicken, rest 10 minutes, then dredge again.
Fry at 325–350°F until deep golden and 165°F (175°F for thighs), 12–18 minutes depending on size. Drain on a rack.
